Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

problem — something that is wrong. Example: The main problem is noise.
broken — not working. Example: My phone is broken.
lost — not able to be found. Example: I have lost my ticket.
late — after the expected time. Example: I am late for work.
wrong — not correct. Example: I think that is wrong.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Can you help me?
• My phone is broken.
• I have lost my ...
• I am late.
• What is the problem?
